channel.title: The Coin Wire
channel.description: Crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, regulation and protocol upgrades: what changed, and what comes next.

item.title: US court clears seizure of $1.2bn in Binance hack funds
item.description: US authorities secured court authorization to seize or restrain more than $1.2 billion of Binance hack proceeds tied to North Korea, while tracing and freezes continue.

item.title: US Wins Court Authority Over $1.2B in Binance Hack Crypto
item.description: The Justice Department secured court authority over more than $1.2 billion of Binance hack proceeds, part of $2.7 billion frozen by public and private efforts.

item.title: Ethlabs calls for Ethereum quantum defenses by 2027
item.description: Ethlabs wants Ethereum to reach post-quantum readiness in 2027, a year ahead of its cited 2028 target, trading near-term features for earlier protection.

item.title: Alta raises $47.5 million for institutional blockchain
item.description: Alta raised $47.5 million in a Series A led by Index Ventures, bringing total funding to $80 million for a blockchain built around institutional privacy and compliance.

item.title: Across restores domain after phishing takeover exposed users to wallet drains
item.description: Across recovered its domain after a registrar attack sent visitors to a phishing site; the bridge says it will repay affected users and publish a post-mortem.

item.title: Visa adds Monad as a stablecoin settlement option
item.description: Visa has added Monad as a stablecoin settlement option for participating issuers and acquirers, widening its blockchain choices as settlement volume grows.

item.title: Visa adds Monad as stablecoin settlement option
item.description: Visa has added Monad as a settlement option for participating issuers and acquirers, widening its stablecoin rails as annualized volume tops $25 billion.

item.title: FinCEN orders U.S. institutions to block MEXC transfers
item.description: FinCEN ordered U.S. institutions to block transfers involving MEXC, citing $16.7 billion in alleged illicit flows; the order takes effect after Federal Register publication.

item.title: Coinbase trust charter takes effect, expanding federal crypto custody
item.description: Coinbase National Trust took effect under OCC oversight on Nov. 6, shifting its custody business from conditional approval to a federal charter without granting deposit-taking powers.

item.title: Zcash NU7 Begins Routing 60% of Fees to Future Rewards
item.description: Zcash activated NU7 at block 3,543,405, cutting target block time to 25 seconds and reserving 60% of fees for future miner rewards without changing its cap.

item.title: FBI links Binance’s $6.3bn theft to North Korea
item.description: The FBI says North Korea’s TraderTraitor stole more than $6bn from Binance, naming wallet addresses for blocking as investigators trace the funds across crypto networks.

item.title: ZetaChain vote sets Dec. 9 target for Solana move and L1 halt
item.description: ZetaChain's second governance vote would end its Layer 1 on Dec. 9 and move native ZETA balances to Solana, while redirecting 55 million tokens from emissions.

item.title: Flashbots relay choice is a trust and coverage trade-off
item.description: Ethereum validators choosing Flashbots relays trade trust in intermediaries against builder coverage; the best setup balances competitive bids with dependable delivery and local fallback.

item.title: Binance’s $6.3bn hack puts withdrawal controls under scrutiny
item.description: Binance paused withdrawals after attackers drained about $6.3 billion from its wallets; the scale dwarfs Bybit’s 2025 loss and tests freeze-and-reimburse measures.

item.title: The berachain bridge choice: USDC.e or USDT0?
item.description: Berachain apps choosing USDC.e or USDT0 should start with user funding routes and in-app liquidity, since the dollar tokens use different bridge designs.

item.title: Schroders takes emerging-markets debt strategy onto Solana
item.description: Schroders and Centrifuge have launched a tokenized feeder into the asset manager’s emerging-markets bond strategy on Solana, extending onchain funds beyond cash-like debt.

item.title: Binance traces $6.34bn crypto heist to months-long intrusion
item.description: Binance says attackers spent months compromising employees before using wallet signing access to move $6.34bn, exposing limits in how exchanges contain on-chain threats.

item.title: Binance details $6.34 billion security incident and recovery
item.description: Binance’s Nov. 3 update details unauthorized wallet transfers, $2.85 billion frozen or intercepted and a plan to cover losses as an independent review begins.

item.title: SyncSwap Slippage Starts With the Minimum You’ll Accept
item.description: Slippage tolerance sets the output floor for a swap, not a guaranteed price; choose it by checking minimum received against volatility, route depth and trade size.

item.title: Binance expands phased withdrawals after $6.3 billion hack
item.description: Binance has begun reopening withdrawals in phases after a $6.3 billion hot-wallet theft, while the scale of losses and recovery tests exchange trust.
